Character sprites extracted from Yakimochi Stream (ヤキモチストリーム).

The assets used for this collection were extracted from the 2022 official
Chinese release.

Due to the large number of character sprite assets and valid expression
combinations, the complete collection has been divided into four galleries.

Parts 1–3 contain all character sprites that actually appear in the game,
as well as unused base sprite assets combined only with expression variants
that are valid according to the game's original composition rules.

This gallery is Part 2 of 4.

从《ヤキモチストリーム（Yakimochi Stream）》游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

本合集所使用的资源提取自 2022 年官方中文版。

由于本作立绘素材及有效表情组合数量较多，
完整的人物立绘合集共分为四个画廊上传。

第一至第三卷收录游戏中实际出现过的全部人物立绘，
同时收录游戏资源中存在但未实际使用的立绘底图，
并仅按照游戏原始合成规则生成有效的表情组合。

本画廊为人物立绘合集第二卷，共四卷。
